name: Card
description: A container component for grouping related content with a rounded border, background, and shadow. Composed of six sub-components for structured layout: Card (root), CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter. All sub-components are forwardRef div elements with className merging.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the card root. Default styles: rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content, typically composed of CardHeader, CardContent, and CardFooter sub-components.

subComponents.name: CardHeader
subComponents.description: The top section of the card. Renders as a flex column with space-y-1.5 gap and p-6 padding.

subComponents.name: CardTitle
subComponents.description: The title element inside CardHeader. Styled as font-semibold with tight leading and tracking.

subComponents.name: CardDescription
subComponents.description: A secondary description below the title. Styled as text-sm text-muted-foreground.

subComponents.name: CardContent
subComponents.description: The main content area of the card. Padded with p-6 pt-0 (no top padding to flow from header).

subComponents.name: CardFooter
subComponents.description: The bottom section of the card. Renders as a flex row with items-center, padded with p-6 pt-0.

props.name: children
props.description: Footer content, typically actions or metadata.

accessibility.role: Renders as plain div elements. No implicit ARIA role. Add role='region' with aria-label if the card represents a distinct landmark.
accessibility.keyboard: Not interactive by default. Interactive children (buttons, links) handle their own keyboard behavior.
accessibility.aria: No built-in ARIA attributes. Use appropriate heading levels inside CardTitle for document outline (e.g., wrap in h2/h3).
accessibility.notes: CardTitle renders as a div, not a heading element. If semantic heading hierarchy is needed, nest a heading element inside CardTitle.
